RBI Report Highlights Economic Resilience Amidst Global Shocks

A recent RBI report indicates India's domestic financial system remains resilient despite external shocks and geopolitical risks. While the near-term economic outlook is uncertain due to factors like AI-based cyber threats and potential 'El Niño' effects, the medium-term outlook is described as clean. The central bank's recent policy moves are also seen as a tailwind for the banking sector and domestic debt markets.
